name: alpha-meta-token-scanner
description: Alpha Meta Token Scanner — monorepo: NestJS alpha-call pipeline backend + React/Vite dashboard frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node -e "console.log('Backend logs → apps/backend/logs/backend-development.log');" && LOG_DIR=apps/backend/logs node scripts/cleanup-ports.mjs --force 3030 && LOG_DIR=apps/backend/logs npm run start:dev -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/backend && npm run build -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/frontend
scripts.test:ci: npm run test -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/backend --if-present && npm run test -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/frontend --if-present && npm run test -w @alpha-meta-token-scanner/ingestion-service --if-present
